title: First Contact
description: Home base has builders and cargo to spare. Get cargo flowing out to the frontier outpost, and keep the network a simple tree — no loops.

narrative.intro: Scouts found a viable outpost site two jumps out. Home base is stocked and ready. Route cargo out to the frontier outpost, and keep it simple: one path between any two points, no redundant loops burning route budget.
narrative.outro: A tree network moved everything it needed to with the fewest possible routes. Every extra edge you don't build is a route you don't have to defend later.

goals.description: Deliver at least 5 cargo to the Frontier Outpost.
Every outpost must be reachable — one connected network.
No loops: the network must stay a tree.
